title: Party
description: An actor exists — person or organisation. Persons need only a name and one contact route; identity binds late (§4). 'Worker' is a role a Party holds, not a type.

contactRoutes.description: At least one, because W2 is unenforceable against a Party nobody can reach.

identityBindings.description: Append-only. Re-binding adds a record; history is never rewritten (§4.1). The assurance level is derived from these, never stored.

subjectRef.description: The provider's pairwise subject identifier. With eSignet this partitions by relying party, not by client (finding E6).

nationalIdHash.description: For matching only. A salted hash and the salt's identifier — never the identifier itself, and never for fixtures either (W9).

mergedInto.description: Set when a registry custodian merged this Party into another, with the worker's confirmation (§4). The Party is not deleted and its identifier keeps resolving: every claim, credential and payment instruction that names it lives in other services, and removing it would put a hole in a worker's history exactly where the system corrected its own mistake about who they were. Reads follow the pointer.
